topic.title: Review Tasks
topic.shortdesc: Review tasks provide a shared review space where task owners and reviewers can collect feedback, discuss changes, and track review progress.

body.p: In , review tasks are used to collect feedback on content. A task owner shares content with reviewers, who open the task in a browser-based editor to read the content, add comments, and suggest changes.
Review tasks support a focused review workflow. Instead of sending files by email, authors can share a link to a task and keep comments, suggestions, and discussions in one place.
supports two types of review tasks: Project Review Tasks and Independent Review Tasks. To learn more about review task types and workflow, see Types of Review Tasks and Review Task Status.

section.title: What You Can Do in a Review Task
section.p: In a review task, you can:

ul.li: Read the documents included in the review.
Reply to comments and join discussions.

section.p: If you create your own review task, you can also manage access and control the review workflow.

section.title: Roles in a Review Task
section.p: Within a review task, users participate through .

ul.li: Owner - Manages the task, shares access, and controls the review workflow.
Reviewer - Reviews the content, adds comments, suggests changes, and joins discussions.

section.p: Users with the Subject-Matter Expert platform user role usually participate in review tasks as reviewers. They can also create and manage their own review tasks.
